|strategy=By [mailto:Red.13@psu.edu Ryan Werntz], Red 13<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20010321011721/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/small/wioslea.html</ref>

Not only does [[Wioslea]] have a great deploy to power ratio, she has a destiny of 5 which fits right into an insert based deck. Deploy her at the [[Cloud City: Incinerator]] and couple her with [[Spaceport Speeders]] and an [[R2-X2 (Artoo-Extoo)]] and you have a great combination which allows you to activate a lot of Force without losing any cards. Place her in a [[Cloud City Sabacc]] based deck and you have a gambler and a great draw during Sabacc games.

Combos:

[[Wioslea]] + [[Cloud City: Incinerator]] + [[Spaceport Speeders]] + [[R2-X2 (Artoo-Extoo)]] - to create a great Force generator!

[[Wioslea]] + [[Cloud City Sabacc]] - to help you win Sabacc games!
|rulings=* This may not target an [[Undercover]] droid.<ref name="scomp" />
